intro: Uzbekistan's economy rests on gold, gas, cotton and money sent home by workers in Russia.

chapters.title: Gold, gas and cotton
text: Uzbekistan is one of the world's biggest gold producers, from the Muruntau mine. It also exports natural gas and copper, and grows cotton and fruit.
Millions of Uzbeks work abroad, mainly in Russia.

chapters.title: Tourism
text: Tourism to the Silk Road cities has grown fast since visa rules were relaxed.
